exam.tagline: AFAA's NCCA-accredited personal trainer credential — the practical, group-fitness-rooted path to coaching one-on-one clients.
exam.description: The AFAA Certified Personal Trainer (AFAA-CPT) is a National Commission for Certifying Agencies (NCCA)-accredited credential from the Athletics and Fitness Association of America, a fitness-education leader since 1983. The exam is a 120-question, computer-based test (120 minutes) delivered through PSI, requiring a scaled score of 70% to pass. The curriculum emphasizes practical, client-centered training built on exercise science, assessment, program design, and coaching rather than heavy theory memorization. It suits career-changers and fitness enthusiasts who want a respected, widely accepted entry-level personal training credential. Because AFAA operates within the NASM/Ascend Learning family, the CPT pairs naturally with NASM specializations such as the Certified Nutrition Coach.

quickAnswer.summary: The AFAA Certified Personal Trainer (AFAA-CPT) is an NCCA-accredited, entry-level personal training credential from the Athletics and Fitness Association of America. To earn it you pass a 120-question computer-based exam (100 scored + 20 pretest, 120 minutes) at a scaled score of 70%, delivered by PSI at a test center or via live online proctoring.

exam.prerequisites: Candidates must be at least 18 years old, hold a high school diploma or equivalent, and hold a current CPR/AED certificate (e.g., American Heart Association or Red Cross) before sitting for the exam.
exam.eligibility: There are no degree or work-experience requirements to enroll. Anyone 18 or older who meets the age, education, and CPR/AED prerequisites may register for the AFAA-CPT. The credential is open to career-changers, current fitness staff, and students, and it does not require a bachelor's degree or prior personal training experience.

faqs.q: How do I register for the AFAA-CPT exam?
faqs.a: Purchase a study package on the AFAA website (afaa.com). After enrollment, AFAA issues a PSI authorization so you can schedule the exam at a PSI test center or via PSI's online proctoring.

faqs.q: How much does the AFAA-CPT cost?
faqs.a: The Self-Study certification package (course plus exam) starts at about $499, while a standalone exam or retake is about $199. Promotion pricing changes often, so verify the current amount on afaa.com before purchasing.

The exam has 120 multiple-choice questions (100 scored plus 20 unscored pretest) and a 120-minute limit. You must reach a scaled score of 70% to pass, and you see a pass/fail result on screen immediately.

faqs.q: What if I do not pass?
faqs.a: You may retake the exam; a retake fee of about $199 applies. The specific waiting period between attempts should be confirmed with AFAA/PSI when you schedule.

faqs.q: How do I keep the AFAA-CPT active?
faqs.a: Renew every 2 years by earning 1.5 CEUs (15 contact hours) of AFAA-approved continuing education, keeping a current CPR/AED certificate, and paying the $99 recertification fee.

program.body: Athletics and Fitness Association of America
program.about: The Athletics and Fitness Association of America (AFAA) has been a leading fitness-education provider since 1983 and is best known for its group fitness instructor program. Its Certified Personal Trainer (AFAA-CPT) is NCCA-accredited and operates within the NASM/Ascend Learning family of credentials. Exams are delivered through PSI Services at U.S. test centers and via live remote proctoring.

registrationSteps.title: Confirm prerequisites
registrationSteps.description: Be at least 18 years old, hold a high school diploma or equivalent, and have a current CPR/AED certificate before you sit for the exam.

registrationSteps.title: Choose a study package
registrationSteps.description: Select a Self-Study or guided-support package on afaa.com and complete your purchase. The package includes the exam registration.

registrationSteps.title: Complete the coursework
registrationSteps.description: Work through the online, self-paced modules, instructional videos, and practice quizzes that cover exercise science, assessment, programming, and coaching.

registrationSteps.title: Get your PSI authorization
registrationSteps.description: After enrollment AFAA issues a scheduling authorization so you can book the exam through PSI.

registrationSteps.title: Schedule with PSI
registrationSteps.description: Book a seat at a PSI test center or choose PSI's live online remote proctoring. Exams are offered year-round.
registrationSteps.note: You need a government-issued photo ID at check-in.

registrationSteps.title: Take the exam and earn the credential
registrationSteps.description: Complete the 120-question, 120-minute exam. You see a pass/fail result on screen immediately, and your certificate and official score post to your AFAA account.

program.proctoring: Live proctored by PSI — in person at a PSI test center or via PSI's online remote proctoring from a home computer. A government-issued photo ID is required at check-in.
program.retakePolicy: If you do not pass, you may retake the exam; a retake fee of about $199 applies. The required waiting period between attempts should be confirmed with AFAA/PSI at the time of scheduling.
program.recertification: AFAA-CPT must be renewed every 2 years. Requirements: earn 1.5 CEUs (15 contact hours) of AFAA-approved continuing education (at least 0.2 CEU from an AFAA-developed course), maintain a current CPR/AED certificate, and pay the $99 recertification fee.
program.scoreReporting: A pass/fail result is shown on screen immediately after the exam. Official results and your certificate are posted to your AFAA account, and the score report is also available through PSI.
program.refundPolicy: Enrollment and package refunds follow AFAA's purchase terms and typically apply only within a short window after purchase. The exam fee becomes non-refundable once the exam is scheduled. Confirm current terms on afaa.com.
program.providersNote: AFAA is owned by Ascend Learning and operates within the NASM family of credentials. The AFAA-CPT exam is delivered exclusively through PSI Services; there is no other authorized testing vendor.

orgFaqs.a: Yes. The AFAA Certified Personal Trainer is accredited by the National Commission for Certifying Agencies (NCCA), which is the standard employers look for in a personal training credential.

orgFaqs.q: Can I take the exam online?
orgFaqs.a: Yes. The exam is delivered by PSI and can be taken at a PSI test center or through PSI's live remote online proctoring from your home computer.

orgFaqs.q: How long is the credential valid and how do I renew?
orgFaqs.a: The AFAA-CPT is valid for 2 years. Renew by earning 1.5 CEUs of AFAA-approved continuing education, keeping a current CPR/AED certificate, and paying the $99 recertification fee.
